title: 21 in. 20-Volt Cordless Electric Manual Walk Behind Self Propelled Mower with Two 12 Ah Flexvolt Batteries and Charger
description:
Description
Featuring a brushless, direct drive motor that delivers up to 70-minutes of runtime in 1 charge, this self-propelled lawn mower has the power you need to get the job done. Innovative, auto-sensing technology achieves higher RPM so you can cut thicker grass whether you are mulching, bagging or using the side discharge. with a fold-over handle for convenient transport and integrated vertical storage, this cordless mower takes up 70% less space in your garage than it does when in operation. Count on the DEWALT Rear Wheel Drive Self-Propelled Lawn Mower to deliver the power needed to tackle your lawn in comfort.
High-efficiency performance: brushless direct drive motor delivers high-voltage cutting
Trouble-free transport with fold-over handle and convenient lift handles
Get more done: 3-in-1 mulching, bagging and side discharge options for natural lawn fertilization or a clip-free aesthetic
Compact for convenient storage: takes up 70% less space in vertical storage verses in operation
Range of cutting options: cuts grass from 1-1/2 in. to 4 in. tall with dual-lever height adjustment
Operate with ease: adjustable self-propelled to decrease your workload
Cut thicker grass: innovative auto-sensing technology allows for higher RPM
Up to 70-minutes of runtime per charge using 2 DEWALT 20-Volt maximum DCB612 12.0 Ah batteries
Traction: premium 11 in. rear wheels for improved traction
